Mettre un produit sur le marché ; le rendre disponible à la vente.

examples.text: Notre premier objectif final était de produire un cédérom interactif de la Bible Porta qui puisse être éventuellement commercialisé et qui de ce fait doit être multiplate-forme même si le produit de base est établi sur Macintosh.

glosses: Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of commercialize.
To bring into commerce from an earlier condition (such as idea alone, experimental prototypes alone, or one-off custom builds only).

examples.text: the work required not only to invent a device but also to commercialize it

glosses: To apply business methodology to something in order to profit (such as introducing salability to a resource that comes from, or rightfully belongs to, the commons).

examples.text: finding the right balance in paying for water infrastructure (treatment plants and pipe networks) but not commercializing water to the point of excluding low-income people from adequate access to a basic necessity

glosses: To exploit something for maximum financial gain, sometimes by sacrificing quality.

examples.text: a market district formerly served mainly by artisans but increasingly commercialized for mass tourism
